services.desc: In these protected waters, civilization seems miles away. About We set sail from the south west end of West Grand Traverse Bay to the destination that I fondly refer to as “Bahamas North” or Power Island. This magical world glistens with aqua blue water so clear that you can view the golden sand 30 feet below. We can set anchor to play in these waters, enjoy a picnic, sip your favorite beverage, and bask in the golden rays of the sun. Or we can simply sail through and enjoy the passing sites as we round the island and continue our journey. The choice and the day are yours.
